mira: Quick Q re: BYOK / HSM custody boundaries for Private deployments. Customer asked whether we can ever see key material if they import keys into an HSM. Short answer? Also what audit logs we can expose to them. cc @jordan @leah

jordan: Short: no. With BYOK + HSM import (CloudHSM or external FIPS modules) key material is non-exportable; we only hold handles/refs. Important to document the boundary for SOC2/PCI.

leah: Agree. Also call out what metadata we DO see: key_id, create_time, last_used, usage_counts, and rotation events. We can offer tamper-evident signed audit logs and delivery (customer S3 or push endpoint).

samir: One more wrinkle: RBAC for ops. If we need operator tasks (attach/detach, rotate references) we must ensure roles cannot extract keys. Propose roles: `kms_admin_platform` (attach/detach), `kms_viewer` (read metadata), `customer_admin` (full lifecycle in tenant).

mira: For audit logs retention/format — customer asked for 7 years for compliance. Feasible? Also want an example log line for Decrypt vs Sign operations.

leah: 7 years is heavy but doable as a paid retention add-on. We should provide newline-delimited JSON logs with fields: `timestamp`, `key_id`, `operation`, `principal`, `request_id`, `success`, `origin_ip`. Example:

`{"timestamp":"2024-11-10T18:22:33Z","key_id":"cust:abc123","operation":"Decrypt","principal":"platform:svc-infer-1","request_id":"r-xx","success":true}`

jordan: Need to cover incident scenarios: if a customer revokes/zeroizes their key while requests are in flight, what's the behavior? Fail closed (preferred for compliance) vs graceful fallback to alternate model. We need a clear policy and config knobs.

samir: Proposal: default = fail closed. Add explicit customer config `allow_public_fallback=true` to opt into fallback (document latency/SLO changes). On failure we return HTTP 403 with error code `KMS_KEY_REVOKED` and include `request_id`.

mira: Good. Also vuln triage: if an integration bug leaks metadata (no key material) and that metadata maps to customer PII, we may have notification obligations under GDPR/PCI. We should add notification templates and thresholds.

leah: Add notif flow to runbook: severity matrix -> legal review -> 72-hour initial notice if customer data affected. Runbook checklist: `isolate`, `preserve_audit_logs`, `rotate_service_tokens`, `notify_customer_success`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Config PR #4321 merged for `kms_role_binding` changes to add `kms_viewer`. Deployed to staging at 2024-11-10T20:15:00Z :rocket:

mira: I'll draft an internal security policy doc + a customer-facing FAQ. Owners: @leah (audit/logs), @samir (RBAC/fallback), @jordan (incident runbook). I'll ping Legal for notification template. ETA: EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
